headline: Wargame simulation finds solar geoengineering could spark a geopolitical arms race
summary: A first-of-its-kind simulation wargamed solar geoengineering and found that letting geopolitics drive the decision could go badly: the technology could buy humanity time against climate change, but could also trigger a dangerous new arms race between nations.

sources.quote: A first-of-its-kind simulation offered a glimpse of what happens when geopolitics takes the wheel.
